# UX, Copy & Accessibility Requirements Checklist: Passwordless Email Login for Enquirers

**Purpose**: Validate that the requirements describing what a visitor reads, sees, and can operate — across success, refusal, limited, locked, empty, and session-ended states — are complete, unambiguous, and objectively verifiable.
**Created**: 2026-09-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Depth**: Lightweight sanity pass — highest-risk requirement gaps only
**Audience**: Author, self-audit before `/speckit-tasks` and `/speckit-implement`

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is every distinct visitor-facing message this feature introduces enumerated in one place, so none of the refusal, limited, locked, expired, empty, and session-ended states is left without defined copy? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, §FR-015, §FR-018, §FR-019, §FR-020, §FR-025, §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for what the visitor sees while a code request is in flight, given the response is deliberately padded to a fixed duration? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Is a mapping specified from each existing enquiry status to the visitor-facing wording that must be shown, rather than leaving "plain language" to interpretation at build time? [Gap, Spec §FR-028, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for how a visitor corrects a mistyped address after seeing the standard confirmation, given that screen is the only place they can recover? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [ ] CHK005 Is the form of "when they can try again" specified — an absolute time, a relative duration, or a countdown — so all three limit messages are consistent? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, §FR-019, §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "the same accessibility baseline as the rest of the site" resolved to a named, checkable standard rather than a reference to an undocumented baseline? [Measurability, Spec §FR-043]
- [ ] CHK007 Can "without becoming stuck" be objectively evaluated, or does the keyboard-and-phone criterion need a definite pass condition? [Measurability, Spec §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK008 Does "the sign-in and enquiry-status pages" have a definite membership — does it include the code-entry step and individual enquiry detail views? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-042, §FR-043]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Are the session-ended message and the after-sign-out state specified as distinct, so a deliberate sign-out does not read as an unexpected failure? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024, §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the refusal messages for a used, expired, and superseded code specified consistently with respect to how much each may say? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §FR-015, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the requirement that the sign-in page carry no navigation entry consistent with every route into it that the spec does define? [Consistency, Spec §FR-045, §FR-048, §FR-044]

## Edge Case & Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK012 Are requirements defined for entering the code on a phone — how the code is typed or pasted from an email opened on the same device? [Gap, Coverage, Spec §FR-043]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the empty state's explanation specified in enough detail that someone whose pre-cut-over enquiry is invisible understands why, rather than concluding it was lost? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- CHK001 and CHK003 exist because Constitution §V requires every string to come from the copy layer; an unenumerated message is one that gets hardcoded under time pressure
